style: STYLE: traditional Chinese shadow puppet (piying) figure exactly like the reference image: dyed translucent leather in cinnabar red, bronze-gold, black lacquer and deep brown, intricate hollowed-out lace carving cut clean through the leather, crisp flat silhouettes with fine dark carved outlines, warm backlit glow, small round antique-bronze rivets at every joint. Flat 2D, no perspective, no cast shadows.

parts.prompt:
Use case: production sprite atlas for a 2D cutout puppet rig in a side-scrolling game. Take the FOURTH character in the attached image (the right-most woman warrior: horned red demon mask headdress worn on top of her head, long dark ponytail, carved bronze armour bodice, armoured bracers and fur-trimmed armoured greaves, ragged red and brown leather skirt panels with red tassels, holding a long polearm with a carved crescent moon blade) and rebuild her as separate cutout pieces. Keep her outfit, colours, mask, weapon and carved lace style. Keep the costume tasteful: armour bodice covers the chest fully.
Strict RIGHT-facing side profile, orthographic, every piece at the same scale as each other.
Technical layout is critical: landscape 3:2 atlas, exactly three rows of four columns, one separate piece centred in each cell, generous empty gutters, pieces never touch each other or the cell edges, no labels, no text, no assembled figure, no extra objects. Background: fully transparent if possible, otherwise perfectly flat pure white #FFFFFF; the carved lace holes must show the background through them. Do not paint white or near-white colour on the puppet itself; the lightest colour is warm amber.
Every limb piece hangs straight down with its upper joint end at the TOP as a rounded disc with one bronze rivet at the disc centre, and its lower end rounded where the next piece overlaps.
ROW 1 left to right: (1) head and neck in side profile facing right, elegant shadow-puppet face (long almond eye, straight nose, red lips), the horned red demon mask pushed up on top of the head as a headdress, hair ornaments, neck ends in a rounded disc with rivet at the bottom; (2) a separate long dark ponytail with red ribbons and tassels, root at the upper RIGHT, flowing down and back to the LEFT; (3) armless torso: carved bronze armour bodice from collar to waist belt, covering the chest, round rivet disc at the shoulder, no arms; (4) hip panel directly under the belt: layered short ragged leather skirt with carved lace, top edge straight.
ROW 2 left to right: (1) upper arm hanging straight down: bare shoulder disc with rivet at top, carved armlet, ends at the elbow; (2) forearm hanging straight down with a long carved bronze bracer, ends at the wrist, no hand; (3) tightly clenched right fist seen from the side, wrist at the TOP, fingers curled around an invisible round pole that runs from upper-left to lower-right, a clear round hole through the fist where the pole goes, no weapon; (4) open left hand, wrist at the top, slender relaxed fingers, separate fingers.
ROW 3 left to right: (1) thigh hanging straight down from a rounded hip disc with rivet to the knee, bare thigh with a carved garter band; (2) shin with the fur-trimmed carved armoured greave and boot as one piece, top at the knee with a rivet disc, toes pointing RIGHT, flat sole; (3) the polearm lying horizontally across the cell: long dark shaft with red ribbon and tassels near the head, butt end on the LEFT, carved crescent moon blade head on the RIGHT; (4) a long ragged red leather skirt streamer panel hanging straight down from a short straight top edge, carved lace, red tassel at the bottom.
